review_candidates.title: Business Central Developer
review_candidates.description: TRIMIT Group er tekstil-, møbel- og industrivirksomheders foretrukne ERP-leverandør og sparringspartner. Brancheløsningen TRIMIT er en komplet standardløsning skræddersyet til de enkelte branchers behov baseret på Microsoft Dynamics Business Central. Cirka 10.000 brugere benytter allerede TRIMIT til at skabe mere omsætning med færre ressourcer. TRIMIT Group består af fantastiske mennesker i en passioneret organisation med en unik kultur. Vi er et internationalt team på mere end 120 højt specialiserede medarbejdere i Danmark, Tyskland, Norge, Holland og Schweiz. Vi repræsenterer den verden, vi lever i, og vi fejrer vores mangfoldighed i baggrunde og kulturer. For at imødekomme den stigende efterspørgsel og vækst på virksomhedens helhedsløsninger søges der nu en fagligt stærk og innovativ BC-udvikler. Moderne ERP-udvikling i Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Brænder du for Business Central-udvikling, og ønsker du at arbejde med moderne ERP-løsninger? Så er dette en spændende mulighed for at bringe dine udviklingskompetencer og din tekniske forretningsforståelse i spil hos en af Danmarks førende Microsoft-partnere inden for ERP-løsninger. Der tilbydes en alsidig stilling med stor frihed, fagligt ansvar og mulighed for at præge løsningerne fra idé til implementering. Samtidig bliver du en del af et unikt arbejdsmiljø præget af høj faglighed, stærkt sammenhold og en kultur, hvor innovation, vidensdeling og kontinuerlig udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af fremtidens ERP-løsninger baseret på Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central og TRIMIT. Rollen indebærer tæt samarbejde med konsulenter, kunder og øvrige udviklere, hvor du bidrager til at omsætte forretningsbehov til værdiskabende tekniske løsninger. Du indgår i et team på ca. 15 BC-udviklere, hvilket giver rig mulighed for faglig sparring. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være at: • Designe og udvikle skalerbare løsninger i Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central • Udvikle og vedligeholde integrationer til ERP-relaterede systemer, API’er og tredjepartsplatforme • Arbejde med både cloud- og on-premise-løsninger • Deltage i implementeringsprojekter fra design og udvikling til idriftsættelse • Bidrage til opgraderings- og optimeringsprojekter hos eksisterende kunder • Indgå aktivt i arkitekturdrøftelser og udvikling af best practices • Samarbejde tæt med konsulenter om at omsætte forretningskrav til tekniske løsninger • Sikre høj kvalitet gennem test, dokumentation og code reviews • Bidrage til et moderne udviklingsmiljø med fokus på innovation, kvalitet og kontinuerlig forbedring For at få succes i rollen har du erfaring som Business Central Developer, Dynamics NAV Developer eller fra en tilsvarende udviklingsrolle inden for ERP. Din erhvervserfaring er mere væsentlig end din uddannelse, da der kan være flere veje ind i jobbet. Du har solid erfaring med AL-udvikling, og det anses som en fordel, hvis du også har kendskab til C/AL. Du arbejder naturligt med moderne udviklingsværktøjer som Visual Studio Code, GitHub eller DevOps og har forståelse for moderne udviklingsmetoder og kvalitetsprocesser. Du kommunikerer på dansk og engelsk i skrift såvel som tale, og du bor i hensigtsmæssig kørselsafstand til virksomhedens lokation i Viborg, Kolding eller København. Som person er du nysgerrig, løsningsorienteret og fagligt ambitiøs. Du motiveres af at skabe robuste og værdiskabende løsninger, og du trives i en rolle, hvor teknologi, innovation og forretningsforståelse går hånd i hånd. Du arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret, samtidig med at du evner at bevare overblikket i komplekse udviklingsprojekter. Du tager ansvar for dine leverancer og drives af at skabe løsninger af høj kvalitet. Samtidig er du en stærk holdspiller, der værdsætter samarbejde, sparring og vidensdeling med kollegaer på tværs af fagområder. Med din proaktive tilgang, tekniske nysgerrighed og evne til at omsætte idéer til konkrete løsninger bidrager du aktivt til både teamets og virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling og succes. Er du TRIMITs nye BC-udvikler? Så skynd dig at uploade din ansøgning og CV enten på dansk eller engelsk. For yderligere information om stillingen kan henvendelse rettes til Sensu A/S, Thomas Bech på tlf. +45 22 89 89 76 Du kan læse mere om TRIMIT Group her: www.trimit.com.

review_candidates.title: Balance Sheet Substantiation – CA Qualified Professionals
review_candidates.description: Job Description: Balance Sheet Substantiation 1. Position Details Job Title: Balance Sheet Substantiation Domain: Banking & Financial Services (BFSI) Experience: 9+ Years Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory Band: C1 Location: Chennai / Pune Budget: Up to ₹35 LPA Function: Finance / Financial Control / Record-to-Report (R2R) 2. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Chartered Accountant with strong expertise in Balance Sheet Substantiation, General Ledger (GL) Reconciliation, Account Reconciliation and Financial Controls within the Banking and Financial Services domain. The role involves ensuring the accuracy, completeness and integrity of balance sheet accounts through periodic substantiation, reconciliation reviews, variance analysis, open-item monitoring and timely resolution of exceptions. The individual will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Operations, Risk, Audit and other relevant stakeholders to strengthen financial control frameworks and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. Candidates with experience in banking finance operations, captive/shared-services environments, Global Business Services (GBS), or outsourced finance operations supporting banking clients will be preferred. 3. Key Responsibilities A. Balance Sheet Substantiation and Review Perform and review periodic Balance Sheet substantiation to ensure all account balances are accurate, complete, supported by appropriate documentation and aligned with underlying financial records. Validate account balances against supporting schedules, source systems, sub-ledgers and other relevant financial records. Ensure appropriate explanations and supporting evidence are available for material balances and unusual movements. Review account substantiation packages, identify discrepancies and ensure timely resolution of outstanding issues. Monitor compliance with substantiation policies, control standards, review timelines and sign-off requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence for all relevant balance sheet accounts. B. General Ledger and Account Reconciliation Perform and review General Ledger (GL) and account reconciliations to ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial records. Investigate reconciliation breaks, unmatched transactions, unexplained balances and other discrepancies. Coordinate with upstream and downstream teams to resolve differences between GL balances and supporting records. Ensure reconciliations are completed within stipulated timelines and in accordance with the month-end and quarter-end close calendar. Identify recurring reconciliation issues and implement corrective actions to prevent future discrepancies. Ensure appropriate escalation of material, aged or unresolved reconciliation items. C. Open-Item and Ageing Management Monitor open items, aged balances, unreconciled transactions and outstanding exceptions across assigned accounts. Conduct ageing analysis to identify long-pending items, recurring breaks and potential financial or operational risks. Drive timely investigation, resolution, clearance or appropriate write-off of outstanding items, subject to applicable approvals and policies. Maintain ageing trackers, action plans and escalation reports. Engage with relevant stakeholders to establish ownership, target resolution dates and root causes for pending items. Prepare periodic updates on aged items, unresolved breaks and remediation progress for management review. D. Month-End and Quarter-End Close (R2R) Support and oversee Record-to-Report (R2R) activities related to month-end and quarter-end financial close. Ensure timely completion of reconciliations, balance validation, journal-related checks and close-control activities. Validate Trial Balance balances and investigate unusual fluctuations or unexplained movements. Perform Balance Sheet and variance analysis to identify significant changes requiring further investigation. Coordinate with Finance, Treasury, Operations and other teams to resolve close-related issues. Ensure adherence to financial close calendars, reporting deadlines and established governance standards. E. Banking and Financial Services Operations Support financial control and reconciliation activities within a banking or financial services environment. Understand banking-related balance sheet accounts and their associated reconciliation requirements. Experience in reconciling suspense accounts, clearing accounts and Nostro/Vostro accounts will be advantageous. Investigate discrepancies arising from transaction processing, settlement activities, inter-account transfers or differences between operational and accounting records. Coordinate with banking operations and finance teams to resolve breaks and maintain accurate account balances. Ensure appropriate documentation and escalation of unresolved items in line with internal policies. F. Financial Controls, Risk and Audit Support Ensure compliance with established financial control policies, procedures and governance frameworks. Identify control gaps, process weaknesses and potential risks within reconciliation and substantiation activities. Support control testing, remediation activities and continuous improvement initiatives. Maintain documentation and evidence required for internal audits, external audits and management reviews. Work with stakeholders to address audit observations and implement corrective and preventive actions. Knowledge of Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR), Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), and audit substantiation practices will be preferred. G. Stakeholder Management and Process Improvement Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Risk, Operations, IT and other stakeholders to resolve reconciliation issues. Provide periodic reporting on substantiation completion, ageing, exceptions, control breaches and outstanding action items. Identify opportunities to standardise reconciliation procedures and improve operational efficiency. Support automation and process improvement initiatives to reduce manual intervention and recurring errors. Maintain clear documentation of procedures, review controls and escalation mechanisms. Provide guidance and support to team members where the role includes review or oversight responsibilities. 4. Mandatory Skills and Experience Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification is mandatory. Minimum 9 years of relevant professional experience. Strong hands-on experience in Balance Sheet Substantiation, Account Substantiation or Balance Sheet Proofing. Strong knowledge of General Ledger (GL) Reconciliation and Account Reconciliation. Experience in Balance Sheet review, financial controls and variance analysis. Practical experience in open-item management, ageing analysis and exception resolution. Understanding of month-end and quarter-end financial close processes and R2R operations. Prior experience in Banking, Financial Services or Insurance (BFSI). Experience in back-office finance operations, shared services, captive finance centres or outsourced operations supporting banking clients. Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills. 5. Preferred Skills Experience supporting retail banking or corporate banking finance operations. Familiarity with core banking systems and banking-related financial processes. Exposure to Suspense, Clearing and Nostro/Vostro account reconciliation. Working knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle Fusion or PeopleSoft. Knowledge of ICFR, RCSA, financial control frameworks and audit substantiation. Experience with reconciliation tools, financial reporting systems and data-analysis tools. Exposure to process automation, control enhancement and reconciliation optimisation initiatives. 6. Key Competencies Strong attention to detail and financial accuracy. Ability to investigate complex reconciliation breaks and aged balances. Strong understanding of financial accounting and balance sheet controls. Effective communication and stakeholder coordination. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict reporting deadlines. Strong documentation, analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Ownership of issues through investigation, escalation and resolution. 7. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a Chartered Accountant with 9+ years of experience in banking finance operations, financial control or R2R, with substantial hands-on exposure to Balance Sheet Substantiation and GL reconciliations. The candidate should be comfortable reviewing account balances, investigating discrepancies, managing aged items, maintaining audit-ready evidence and ensuring timely financial close. Candidates with experience in global banking operations, financial shared services, captive centres or outsourced finance operations, along with knowledge of banking-specific reconciliation accounts, will be preferred. Interested Candidates can share their Resume at workjyoti007@gmail.com or can whatsapp me at 9147769531

review_candidates.title: Associate Executive - Regulatory & Compliance
review_candidates.description: Company Description We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide. We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top-15 private equity firms. Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts. Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities. Job Description The Associate Executive – Regulatory & Compliance will support the compliance function in preventing, detecting, and responding to compliance, regulatory, and ML/TF risks in accordance with the AML/CFT Framework. You will conduct file reviews and due diligence for client onboarding, assist in designing the KYC Framework, and provide FATCA and CRS compliance support across multiple jurisdictions with minimal supervision. What You Will Do You'll conduct multi-jurisdictional KYC reviews, due diligence, sanctions and World-Check screenings, and account verification to ensure compliant client onboarding and account maintenance. You'll manage KYC documentation, perform file reviews and gap analyses, recommend remedial actions, and ensure client records are accurate, complete, and maintained securely. You'll support FATCA and CRS compliance, monitor regulatory developments, draft and update Key Operating Procedures (KOPs), and provide timely responses to compliance-related queries. You'll deliver high-quality, error-free work in line with agreed timelines, proactively communicate risks or delays, and exercise sound judgment when escalating issues. You'll collaborate with business teams and stakeholders, support and train junior colleagues, protect information assets in line with ISMS requirements, and undertake additional compliance-related duties as needed. What We Offer Comprehensive remuneration: Motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile Pension Scheme: Generous employer contribution with the ability to allow and increase employee contributions Annual leave: All our employees are entitled to 22 days paid leave. Enhanced maternity and paternity, including shared parental leave and adoption leave Flexible working: We recognise the value of working flexibly and is keen to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day Qualifications About You You hold a degree in Law or an equivalent qualification, with prior experience in a similar compliance role is an advantage. You possess strong knowledge of KYC, AML/CFT, FATCA/CRS, and international compliance frameworks, including FATF recommendations, Basel Committee standards, and EU regulations. You can identify potential compliance and risk issues, conduct investigations, and apply sound analytical and problem-solving skills to support regulatory requirements. You are highly proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel, with advanced-level skills and the ability to work accurately with compliance documentation and reporting. You communicate effectively in both English and French and can collaborate confidently with stakeholders across different jurisdictions and business functions. Additional Information Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment. There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee. Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced. We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

review_candidates.description: MADEC Australia MADEC Australia is a successful community‑owned not‑for‑profit organisation with a proud 50+ year history. Employing around 180 staff nationally, MADEC delivers employment services, education, training and workforce solutions, including large‑scale labour hire operations and the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) Scheme. The organisation is undergoing an exciting phase of transformation and business growth and has a number of new positions available. Reporting to the Regional Manager, the Area Manager will lead MADEC’s Employment Services operations across Shepparton and Echuca. This is a strategically important region requiring a capable, commercially minded leader who can build strong teams, embrace KPIs to drive performance and deliver high‑quality services that support participants into meaningful employment. Based in the region and working from either the Shepparton or Echuca office, this role offers the opportunity to combine commercial acumen with genuine people leadership, shaping workplace culture, strengthening accountability and ensuring MADEC’s service delivery meets contractual, operational and community expectations. Key responsibilities include: leading, coaching and developing a high‑performing team of Job Coaches and administration staff across multiple sites; driving performance across participant engagement, employment placements and sustainable outcomes, proactively identifying risks and opportunities for improvement; managing financial forecasting, budgets and performance reporting, translating data into meaningful action; utilising performance data, reporting systems and technology to drive operational improvement; ensuring high‑quality service delivery and compliance with contractual and government program requirements; collaborating with Workforce Partners, Community Liaison Officers, Activity Coordinators and wellbeing practitioners to strengthen participant outcomes; building productive relationships with employers, training providers and community organisations; championing continuous improvement, operational efficiency and a positive, accountable workplace culture. The successful candidate will be a confident, approachable and commercially astute leader with demonstrated experience developing teams, ideally across multiple locations. Strong commercial judgement, capability in financial management, and a constructive proactive approach to coaching and performance management will be essential. Excellent communication, influencing and relationship‑building skills are expected, along with an understanding of compliance, risk management and the importance of delivering against contractual obligations. Experience within Employment Services may be advantageous but is certainly not essential. Accordingly, leaders from other performance‑driven and resource intense industries such as Hospitality, Retail, Aged/Health Care or FMCG, who can build capability, drive results and foster positive workplace cultures are strongly encouraged to apply. A current driver’s licence is essential. Employment screening includes a National Police Check and Working with Children Check. Further Information / How to Apply Visit madec.edu.au for more information about our client. Confidential enquiries are welcome to Justin Hinora on (08) 8100 8827. Visit henderconsulting.com.au to submit your application which should include a cover letter and CV uploaded as one PDF document.
